n: Joseph, Oliver, and John Whitmer are told to spend their time studying scripture, preaching, strengthening the Colesville branch, and doing necessary farm work until the next conference in Fayette (“the west”).

f.g: Fayette lay west of Harmony, Pennsylvania; the conference met there in September 1830.

n: A foundational principle: all things in the Church are done by “common consent” — members sustaining decisions and callings by vote — with much prayer and faith.

f.g: the practice of members raising hands to sustain callings and decisions.
